changelog: **Sales board:** a colleague strip above `/sales/board` and the MARKETING `/admin/board` — drop a lead card on a teammate (or use the card's *Hand over* button) and a dialog asks what they should do next (call / e-mail / appointment / app demo / free text) and by when. The owner moves through `transferMentorship()` (new `quietMentee` option, reason code `sales_handoff`), the instruction lands in the record's follow-up (`nextActionAt`/`nextActionNote`, so the due-day reminder and attention queue apply), and the recipient gets an in-app `lead.handedOff` notice. The lead is told nothing. `GET /api/sales/team`, `POST /api/sales/leads/[id]/handoff`; rule in `src/lib/leadHandoffRule.ts`.

en: Hand a lead to a colleague right from the board: drag the card onto their name and say what's next — call, e-mail, appointment or demo.
tr: Bir müşteri adayını panodan doğrudan bir ekip arkadaşına devredin: kartı adının üzerine sürükleyin ve sıradaki adımı seçin — arama, e-posta, randevu veya demo.
de: Übergib einen Lead direkt vom Board an eine Kolleg:in: Karte auf den Namen ziehen und den nächsten Schritt wählen — Anruf, E-Mail, Termin oder Demo.
